PINE & CO SEOUL · LAST CALL

THE FINAL 20 MINUTES

Closing time is near. The very last call of the night has just rung out across Pine & Co.

Word travels fast down the street — and the customers come pouring in. Thirsty. Restless. Endless.

For twenty long minutes you stand alone behind the bar, shaker in hand, holding the line against the flood.

Do you have what it takes to last the full twenty minutes... until your shift finally ends?
